definitions.explanation: The outer covering of the human body.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんの{肌|はだ}は{柔|やわ}らかい。
{冬|ふゆ}は{乾燥|かんそう}して{肌|はだ}が{荒|あ}れやすい。
examples.english: In winter, the air is dry and skin tends to get rough.

examples.japanese: {肌|はだ}を{守|まも}るために{毎日|まいにち}{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}るようにしている。
examples.english: I make sure to put on sunscreen every day to protect my skin.

examples.japanese: {歳|とし}を{取|と}ると{肌|はだ}が{乾燥|かんそう}しやすくなるので、お{風呂|ふろ}の{後|あと}はいつもクリームを{塗|ぬ}って{気|き}をつけている。
examples.english: As you get older, your skin tends to dry out more easily, so I always apply cream after bathing.

examples.japanese: このタオルは{肌触|はだざわ}りがいい。
examples.english: This towel has a nice texture.

examples.japanese: シルクの{肌触|はだざわ}りが{好|す}きです。
examples.english: I like the feel of silk.

examples.japanese: この{布|ぬの}は{肌触|はだざわ}りが{悪|わる}くて、{着|き}ると{痒|かゆ}くなる。
examples.english: This fabric has a rough feel, and it makes me itchy when I wear it.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんの{服|ふく}を{買|か}うときは、{肌触|はだざわ}りのいい{素材|そざい}を{選|えら}ぶようにしている。
examples.english: When buying baby clothes, I try to choose materials with a soft feel.

examples.japanese: この{布団|ふとん}は{肌触|はだざわ}りがとても{良|よ}くて{気持|きも}ちいいので、{毎晩|まいばん}ぐっすり{眠|ねむ}れるようになった。
examples.english: This futon has such a nice feel that it's comfortable, and I've been sleeping soundly every night.

notes:
{肌|はだ} refers to human skin, particularly focusing on texture, beauty, and feel.

CONTRAST:
- {肌|はだ}: skin (beauty, texture, feel)
- {皮|かわ}: skin, hide, peel (outer layer)
- {皮膚|ひふ}: skin (medical/scientific term)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {肌色|はだいろ}: skin color, flesh tone
- {素肌|すはだ}: bare skin
- {敏感肌|びんかんはだ}: sensitive skin
- {乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}: dry skin
- {脂性肌|しせいはだ}: oily skin
- {肌触|はだざわ}り: texture, feel (of fabric)

EXPRESSIONS:
- {肌|はだ}が{合|あ}う: to suit one's nature, to be compatible
- {肌|はだ}で{感|かん}じる: to feel intuitively
- {鳥肌|とりはだ}が{立|た}つ: to get goosebumps

SKINCARE VOCABULARY:
- {肌|はだ}ケア: skincare
- {美肌|びはだ}: beautiful skin
- {肌|はだ}{荒|あ}れ: rough/irritated skin

RELATED:
- {顔|かお}: face
- {体|からだ}: body
